data.name: Hindatun
data.gender_notes: Hindatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Hind', meaning 'contentment' or 'satisfaction'. The suffix '-atun' is a Persian originated suffix which means 'mother of' in various Islamic cultures. The name Hindatun carries the meaning “Contentment, Satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Hindatun usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Hindatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contentment, Satisfaction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hindatun total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: هنداتون

in_urdu.name: ہنداتون
in_urdu.meaning: ہند سے ماخوذ، خوبصورت نوجوان خاتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہنداتون ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو ہند سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت نوجوان خاتون یا جوان لڑکی۔ یہ نام عربی اور فارسی ثقافتوں میں مقبول ہے اور اسلامی روایات میں بھی اس کا ذکر ملتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصولی جڑیں العربية 'ھند' میں ہیں، جو ایک قدیم اور معروف نام ہے۔
